fig1_empirical_rule.svg: The standard normal density phi(z) with the central bands |z|<=1, 2, 3 shaded. Their areas, from empirical_rule, are about 68.3%, 95.4%, and 99.7% -- the fraction of a normal population within k standard deviations.
fig2_standardization.svg: Left: three normals with different mu and sigma (from normal_pdf). Right: after the z-score z=(x-mu)/sigma from standardize, each density (scaled by sigma) lands exactly on the single standard normal phi(z) shown in grey.
